mapper.select: select d.*, coalesce((select sum(cast(i.quantity_issued as decimal(20,2))) from wm_issue_line i join wm_issue_header h on h.issue_id = i.issue_id where h.status = 'FINISHED' and i.item_id = d.itemId and i.quantity_issued > 0 and (h.workorder_id = #{id} or (h.workorder_id is null and h.workorder_code = #{code}))), 0) issued, coalesce((select sum(cast(s.quantity_onhand as decimal(20,2))) from wm_material_stock s where s.item_id = d.itemId and s.warehouse_code = 'WH-RAW' and s.quantity_onhand > 0 and coalesce(s.frozen_flag, 'N') != 'Y'), 0) onHand from (select item_id as itemId, max(item_code) as itemCode, max(item_name) as itemName, coalesce(max(nullif(unit_name, '')), max(unit_of_measure)) as unit, sum(cast(quantity as decimal(20,2))) as required from pro_workorder_bom where workorder_id = #{id} and item_or_product != 'PRODUCT' and quantity > 0 group by item_id) d order by d.itemCode, d.itemId

select s.material_stock_id, s.item_id, s.item_code, s.item_name, s.specification, s.unit_of_measure, s.unit_name, s.batch_id, s.batch_code, s.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_code, w.warehouse_name, s.location_id, l.location_code, l.location_name, s.area_id, a.area_code, a.area_name, cast(s.quantity_onhand as decimal(20,2)) - coalesce(( select sum(cast(tl.quantity_transfer as decimal(20,2))) from wm_transfer_line tl join wm_transfer t on t.transfer_id = tl.transfer_id where tl.material_stock_id = s.material_stock_id and t.status not in ('FINISHED', 'CANCELED') ), 0) as quantity_onhand from wm_material_stock s join wm_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id join wm_storage_location l on l.location_id = s.location_id and l.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id join wm_storage_area a on a.area_id = s.area_id and a.location_id = l.location_id join wm_batch b on b.batch_id = s.batch_id and b.item_id = s.item_id where s.item_id in #{id} and w.warehouse_type = 'RAW' and w.warehouse_code != 'WH-RAW' and upper(w.warehouse_code) not like '%VIR%' and s.quantity_onhand > 0 and coalesce(s.frozen_flag,'N') = 'N' and coalesce(w.frozen_flag,'N') = 'N' and coalesce(l.frozen_flag,'N') = 'N' and coalesce(a.frozen_flag,'N') = 'N' and a.enable_flag = 'Y' and (s.expire_date is null or s.expire_date >= curdate()) and (b.expire_date is null or b.expire_date >= curdate()) and (b.quality_status is null or b.quality_status in ('', 'OK')) and (s.workorder_id is null or s.workorder_id = 0) and coalesce(s.workorder_code,'') = '' order by s.item_id, s.recpt_date, s.material_stock_id
select transfer_id as transferId, transfer_code as transferCode, status, attr2 as operation from wm_transfer where attr1 = #{tag} order by transfer_id desc
select rule_id from sys_auto_code_rule where rule_code = 'TRANSFER_CODE' for update
